description: Communication persona categories. These are style observations, not identity claims.

categories.label: Teacher
categories.description: Explains ideas with sequencing, definitions, examples, and learning-oriented framing.

categories.label: Explainer
categories.description: Breaks concepts down into causes, patterns, and implications.

categories.label: Commander
categories.description: Uses directive language and decisive calls to action.

categories.label: Coach
categories.description: Encourages action, progress, and practical improvement.

categories.label: Philosopher
categories.description: Reflects on meaning, assumptions, truth, and deeper implications.

categories.label: Storyteller
categories.description: Uses narrative sequence, scenes, stakes, and personal or imagined situations.

categories.label: Analyst
categories.description: Prioritizes evidence, variables, tradeoffs, and structured interpretation.

categories.label: Comedian
categories.description: Uses jokes, surprise, absurdity, or comic reversal.

categories.label: Activist
categories.description: Frames issues around urgency, harm, responsibility, and collective action.

categories.label: Visionary
categories.description: Emphasizes future possibilities, transformation, and large-scale direction.

categories.label: Technical Expert
categories.description: Uses implementation detail, systems vocabulary, and precise procedural claims.

categories.label: Motivational Speaker
categories.description: Uses confidence, momentum, obstacles, and achievement framing.

categories.label: Interviewer
categories.description: Asks questions, follows up, and draws out another speaker.

categories.label: Sales/Pitch Mode
categories.description: Frames value, pain points, benefits, objections, and conversion.
